description: The canon's enforcement layer: session-start injection, tool-call guards and prompt advisories, with their scopes, pre-filter rules and escape hatch (SZA_HOOKS_OFF=1) described in hooks/README.md. Every registration here must appear in the inventory table of that file (check-compliance.ps1 SZA-HOOK01).

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *CLAUDE.md*|*AGENTS.md*|*GEMINI.md*|*MEMORY.md*) printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-rules-budget.ps1" ;; esac

input=$(cat); case "$input" in *find*|*.ps1*|*[a-z]-[A-Z]*|*'& {'*|*'&{'*|*python*|*node*|*'<<'*|*'"/'*|*"'/"*) printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-bash.ps1" ;; esac
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"run_in_background":true'*|*'"run_in_background": true'*) printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-fire-and-forget.ps1" ;; esac
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"limit"'*|*'"offset"'*) exit 0 ;; esac; printf "%s" "$input" | pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard-uncapped-read.ps1"
